trust_decision.summary: Which route rules (appMiddleware auth gates, redirect, ssr, appLayout, prerender) apply to a request path is decided by a build-time compiled rou3 matcher whose keys are inserted verbatim while the runtime lookup path is lower-cased, so any mixed-case rule key never matches and its middleware is silently dropped.

landing_point.why: The summary names route rules and appMiddleware; the appMiddleware merge calls getRouteRules, whose body is the visible `path.toLowerCase()` added by the previous CVE fix.
